title: Listening Drill — Student budgets project
description: Student and tutor dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Student budgets project
sections.transcript:
STUDENT: I've started the project on how students budget. I was going to use a questionnaire, but testing it with one person made me realise that the questions were too broad.

TUTOR: In that case, try spending diaries first. But watch out for missing entries. That can affect what you notice and what you end up writing down.

STUDENT: Would it help if I kept a daily log? I don't want to discover the problem only after I've handed everything in.

TUTOR: A better safeguard here is weekly reminders. Bring the diary template to our next meeting, so we can check it is easy to complete. There is no need to prepare the final presentation yet.
